carbon-black.$description: Carbon Black — Primary text, nav links, body copy, badge text, footer copy — the near-black that carries every word on the site

bone.$description: Bone — Page canvas and primary surface — the warm off-white that fills every section background

ink.$description: Ink — Maximum-contrast text and hard borders, reserved for the strongest emphasis moments

linen.$description: Linen — Subtle elevated surface and section dividers — one step lighter than the canvas for soft separation

ash.$description: Ash — Muted fills, hairline borders, and disabled/inactive surface treatments

parchment.$description: Parchment — Alternate warm section background — introduces a barely-perceptible cream tint to break the neutral flow

stone.$description: Stone — Deepest mid-gray — used for low-emphasis supporting text and the dimmest UI separators

clay.$description: Clay — Warm mid-gray for transitional surfaces between bone and parchment

founders-grotesk.$description: Sole brand typeface. Weight 300 at 70–101px for the monumental editorial hero and section titles; weight 400 at 12–22px for body, nav, meta labels, and case study descriptions. The extreme weight contrast (300 vs 400) and the 5× size jump from body to display are the core typographic moves — no other type system in the palette.

editorial-neue.$description: Secondary editorial serif used sparingly as an accent counterpoint to Founders Grotesk — appears in specific body or pull-text moments to break the grotesque monotony with a classical note. Tight -0.0600em tracking and 0.90 line-height match the display discipline.
